preparationWindowMeaning: From retained preparation script timestamp to dispatch receipt; first image inspection predates this window and was not timestamped, so full preparation time UNKNOWN.
exportSecondsMeaning: Single deterministic export process walltime; exporter implementation/debug/player work not included. End-to-end observed wall time is recorded at freeze.
manualCleanupMeaning: No manualpixelpaint/retouch/fitting; alpha128+palette is deterministic same-protocol export, timed separately.
failures: No tool exception; geometry failures assessed from actual export, not counted as tool failure.
endToEndMeaning: Includes prompts, call, export implementation, receipts/player/checking/waits; excludes first image inspection before retained prep timestamp.
